annotations.text:
Every value on these artboards is in design/tokens.css.

If you need a number that is not in that file, the tokens file is wrong — say so rather than inventing one.

The page has one control the product will not have: the state switcher in the header. Use it to walk all seven states.

The panel shows all six of its states side by side instead, each at the real 380px.

Greyscale test: the answer mark is drawn twice on the foundations board, once with the colour taken away.

The bracket's fill level — full, half, empty — is what carries the answer. Colour is the second signal, never the only one.
